source.author: hor
source.text: saepe stilum vertas, iterum quae digna legi sint scripturus, neque te ut miretur turba labores, contentus paucis lectoribus.
source.text_original: saepe stilum vertas, iterum quae digna legi sint  / scripturus, neque te ut miretur turba labores,  / contentus paucis lectoribus.
source.text_english: Often you should turn your stylus around and write things again that may deserve to be read, and you should not labor so that the crowd may marvel at you, but be content with a few readers.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Se unusquisque consideret, et videbit, quanto libros labore componat, quomodo Saepe stylum vertat iterum, quae digna legi sint, Scripturus;.
reuse.text_original: Se unusquisque consideret, et videbit, quanto libros labore componat, quomodo Saepe stylum vertat iterum, quae digna legi sint, Scripturus;.
reuse.text_english: Let each person consider this for himself, and he will see how much labor he expends in composing books, how often he turns his pen back over the same thing, and what things are worthy to be read, when he is about to write.
